👑 Campaign Generator

"One villain, ten levels, and a clock that never stops ticking. The party will still find a way to adopt the goat."

Roll a whole campaign: a villain with a scheme and a false name, the faction behind them and the one that hires the party, a front that ticks after every chapter, and three to ten chapters, each a full adventure at the party's level as it climbs. It builds on the world in your Campaign Notebook, or rolls its own.

The campaign lives in the address bar, so 🔗 Copy Link shares it and a reload keeps it. 📒 Save to Notebook adds the campaign and each chapter as quests to the Campaign Notebook, linked to the world they stand on, saved in this browser (💾 back up everything). ⚔️ Run this fight opens the fight in the Toolbox's Encounter tab, which can send it to the Initiative tracker.

How to run a rolled campaign

A campaign here is a chain of adventures with one villain behind them all. Read the red box first: who the villain is, what they're after, and the doom if nobody stops them. Every chapter is a full one-shot (a hook, the road, a keyed site, the hoard), and the party climbs a level or two between chapters, from the level you pick to the last chapter's.

The front

The front is a clock with one segment per chapter. Tick one after every chapter, and a second when the party fails a chapter or walks away from it, then read the next segment's line as the news at the start of the next chapter. When it fills, the doom happens, whether or not the party has reached the last chapter. That pressure is what makes a side quest a real choice.

The world and the cast

  • The world comes from your Campaign Notebook: its latest factions, pantheon, and history from the Worldbuilder. With nothing saved, the campaign rolls a small world of its own (pick 🎲 Roll a new world to do that anyway).
  • The villain leads the faction most likely to have one (a cult, a thieves' ring, a noble house), and a rival faction hires the party. A third faction plays both sides.
  • The cast keeps coming back: the patron faction's people hire the party, the villain's lieutenants run the middle chapters, and the villain waits in the last one with the relic everyone wants.

Keep, reroll, and print

🔒 Keep the world, the villain and arc, or any chapter, and 🎲 Roll New Campaign leaves it alone; 🎲 on one part rerolls only that part. A new arc renames the people in every chapter, but each chapter keeps its own site and road. 🖨️ Print the Campaign prints the outline and every chapter, with all the stat blocks at the back; 🖨️ Print This Chapter prints the one you're reading. Want just one adventure? The One-Shot Generator rolls a single chapter's worth.
